issues.reason: Core patterns: 'World knowledge picks the reading; it never adds content' — the text gives no kind word for 'Pirates' (the adjacent lowercase 'manager' types McClendon, not the club), so no words put 'team' there and a name may stand on its Name atom alone.
'An appositive has no tense of its own: its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper — past host -> (Past (Member halvard wheelwright))', and the host clause here is the past 'said'.

'A property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol' — 'quality' is evaluative, incidental description rather than a classifier naming a genuine subtype, so it may not fuse into the kind slot and must go through the distributive rule.

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation / quoted speech ('...,' said X) — the attitude machinery is specified for a finite that-complement, and nothing says whether a verbatim quote is sealed the same way or kept as a string
first- and second-person pronouns ('we') — the pronoun rules enumerate he/she/it/they only, and a quoted 'we' has an antecedent only in the speech situation
new_gaps: distribution inside a seal — the per-member Implication the plural rules mandate has no attested sealed form; this repair nests it under the sealed (And ...) on the strength of the attitude rule 'Parse P as usual ... then seal it', but the shape is unwitnessed in the instruction set
